mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we are looking at clear skies and a temperature of 39 degrees around City Hall with a new moon visible in the night sky.

City news includes a reminder about pavement repairs taking place Tuesday, November 10 and Wednesday, November 11. Work is focused on several streets including Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, with no parking signs enforced from 7 AM to 7 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.

You have a great selection of events starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and more music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, next Tuesday is packed with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus pizza specials at Lake Lou-ee.

In a noteworthy update, on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents for permitting the use of prohibited vehicles.
Today's delicious flavor is Snickers Swirl, and the team will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
